readingProgression.Pre-A: Very short sentences, familiar words, two-word matches and one missing word.
readingProgression.A: Direct sentences, clear details and four-event retelling.
readingProgression.AA: Longer content, linked events and simple reasons.
readingProgression.AAA: Richer vocabulary, motives and connected clues.
readingProgression.AAAA: Layered content, competing explanations, limits and precise evidence.

storiesIndex.title: The Photograph Worth Waiting For
storiesIndex.alt: An adult scuba instructor supervises two children during a beginner lesson in clear shallow water above a sandy seabed. All have coherent fitted scuba gear, masks, regulators and air tanks. Sunlight reaches the visible bottom. Calm close supervision, no animals touched and no deep-water danger.

storiesIndex.title: The Dog at the Closed Gate
storiesIndex.alt: A child with a tan complexion pours fresh water from a small jug into a nearly full metal dog bowl on a shady garden path. A happy golden dog stands beside the bowl with its tongue out, ready for a drink. A coiled lead and closed garden gate appear behind them.

storiesIndex.title: A Quiet Path for a Duckling
storiesIndex.alt: animal rescuers releasing a duckling beside its family at a pond

storiesIndex.title: The Delivery That Went in Circles
storiesIndex.alt: Nia, a Black girl with braided hair, and Arjun, a South Asian boy with glasses, check their small wheeled classroom robot on a table. Arjun reconnects a loose low-voltage plug while Nia watches a green indicator light glow. A delighted teacher stands behind. No exposed mains wiring, no labels.

storiesIndex.title: A Place for the Toy Ambulance
storiesIndex.alt: Lina, an East Asian girl with a yellow top, and Andre, a Black boy in a blue jumper, carefully align craft sticks to make a small model bridge on their classroom table. Their completed bridge spans two supports. A ruler, child-safe glue and a few spare sticks lie neatly nearby.

storiesIndex.title: A Story Without Words
storiesIndex.alt: Sofia, a girl with medium-brown skin and a green cardigan, chooses a book with a colourful picture-only cover and places it on a clear library table. A friend wearing a lavender hijab reads quietly beside her. Warm low shelves, a calm reading nook and no readable lettering on spines or pages.

storiesIndex.title: More Than the Highest Kite
storiesIndex.alt: Asha, a South Asian girl in a coral jacket, and Jamal, a Black boy in teal trousers, share a reel of string in a broad grassy field. Their colourful diamond kite is visibly airborne above them with its string connected to the reel. A small picnic basket and folded blanket sit off to one side. Breezy clouds and open space.

storiesIndex.title: The Bridge on Yesterday's Map
storiesIndex.alt: Two young hikers rest on a fallen log in the shelter of a large rock beside a woodland trail. A girl with dark curly hair points along a clear route on an unfolded map while a blond boy holds binoculars. Water bottles and backpacks rest beside them. A small deer is far away on the hillside. The rock shelters them from the breeze.

storiesIndex.title: A Menu Everyone Could Use
storiesIndex.alt: Two friends, a girl with light-brown skin and glasses and a boy with black hair, sit on a clearly spread yellow picnic blanket in a green park. A woven picnic basket sits between their bags. Lunch containers and apple slices are on the blanket. A level grassy patch beside a broad park path.

storiesIndex.title: The Invitation That Landed in a Bush
storiesIndex.alt: Ben, a red-haired boy, and Maya, a girl with dark braids, test two plain paper gliders on an open grassy lawn. One glider has drifted gently into a low bush while the other rests in Maya's hand. Ben walks toward the bush to retrieve the glider. A coherent outdoor scene with both gliders easy to see.

storiesIndex.title: The Stone with a Spiral
storiesIndex.alt: An adult museum guide shows a large spiral fossil in a low glass display case to a small group of fascinated children. One child uses a manual wheelchair and has a clear view beside the other visitors. A skeleton exhibit is softly visible behind them. No labels or readable signage.

storiesIndex.title: A Solar System That Fit on a Table
storiesIndex.alt: A diverse group of three children in an after-school space club gathers around a tabletop solar-system model. They point to small colourful planets attached to thin supports around a large central sun. Warm classroom, thoughtful curious expressions, no printed labels or floating text.

storiesIndex.title: The Invitation Missing One Thing
storiesIndex.alt: Lina, an East Asian girl in a mustard cardigan, sits at a clear classroom desk. Her open notebook and pencil are prominent as she begins writing. A closed schoolbag is beside the desk. Unreadable small pencil marks only, no printed words.

storiesIndex.title: The Snow Friend Who Leaned
storiesIndex.alt: Two children in warm coats, gloves and boots roll a very large snowball across level snow to build a snowman. A smaller ball waits nearby, with a carrot and two plain pebbles in a basket. The giant lower ball is clearly much larger than their smaller snowballs. Joyful sunny winter park.

storiesIndex.title: A Gate for the Sea
storiesIndex.alt: Mei, an East Asian girl with straight black hair and a sun hat, carries two small buckets full of damp sand toward a sandcastle. Her friend shapes a castle wall nearby. Gentle sea in the background, sunny beach, sensible sun protection and an adult supervising from nearby.

storiesIndex.title: Before the Shiny Ribbon
storiesIndex.alt: Priya, a South Asian girl wearing a fitted riding helmet and closed riding boots, gently brushes a calm brown pony's bare back in a stable aisle. An adult instructor holds the pony's lead rope. A saddle waits separately on a stand, clearly not yet on the pony. Warm calm light.

storiesIndex.title: The Souvenir That Walked
storiesIndex.alt: Two children crouch beside shallow seawater pools between flat coastal rocks at low tide. They look closely at a tiny crab and shells without touching or disturbing them. An attentive adult guide is beside them. Non-slip shoes, stable rock surfaces and gentle daylight.

storiesIndex.title: The Towel That Looked Ready
storiesIndex.alt: A child at a sunny woodland campsite lifts a visibly wet towel from a washing bowl. Water drips from the towel onto the grass as a second child points to a nearby drying line. A tent and a small wash station in the background, one clear everyday action.

storiesIndex.title: The Train That Passed Their Stop
storiesIndex.alt: A family waits together well behind the safety line on a railway platform. An adult conductor checks a child's plain ticket in the foreground while a bright passenger train approaches around a distant curve. Clear safe platform edge and coherent rails. No readable signs, numbers or ticket print.
